verdict.rationale: Incident Workflows can orchestrate a structured, automated response per incident (e.g. auto-triggering for all P1/P2 incidents), and webhooks expose incident-responder changes, so PagerDuty has some coordination scaffolding. The pack never shows named incident roles such as commander or comms lead, or per-incident task checklists. missing for 10: explicit incident role assignment (commander, comms lead), in-incident task checklists, documentation of role/checklist UX, independent or hands-on corroboration.
